purpose: Audition a compact sample-assisted engine against pure synthesis; engine choice remains open.

sounds.brief: One warm electric-piano note, dry, rounded attack, controlled bell partials; save the synth settings.
Same electric-piano preset and velocity as keys_low, one octave higher.
Same electric-piano preset and velocity as keys_mid, one octave higher.

payload.text: A single soft low kick drum hit, rounded warm body, gentle felt-beater attack, short controlled decay. Dry close recording in silence. One hit only, no rhythm, no music, no speech, no reverb.
A single mellow brushed snare drum hit, soft papery texture and a small warm body, restrained high frequencies, short decay. Dry isolated one-shot in silence. No rhythm, music, speech or reverb.
One very short soft closed hi-hat tick, muted dusty texture, gentle transient, no harsh ringing. Dry isolated one-shot with silence after it. No beat, no other instruments, no speech, no reverb.
One gentle wooden drum rim click, warm hollow knock, rounded transient, very short natural decay. Dry isolated single hit in silence. No rhythm, no accompaniment, no voices, no reverb.

optional_later_sources.brief: Quiet fine rain against a small window, steady soft texture, no thunder, voices or music.
A contented cat purring softly, close and quiet, no human voices or music.
Instrumental solo warm electric piano, widely separated single notes, dry and intimate, no percussion or backing instruments.
